reference: The 1963 Armstrong 500 was held at the Mount Panorama Circuit just outside Bathurst, New South Wales, after the Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit was too damaged to continue hosting the race. FINDING: The Armstrong 500 race was moved to Bathurst.
